pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjissanti seyyathāpi gihikāmabhogino 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.6: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te . . . vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjissantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.8: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etam atthaṃ ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.9: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjathā 'ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.12: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjissatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.13: n' etaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya --pa--;
pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np19:1.15.1: yo pana bhikkhu nānappakārakaṃ rūpiyasaṃvohāraṃ samāpajjeyya, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyan ti. ||1||
